title: Weekend Courier to the Reference Laboratory — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
*Specimen logistics notice — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, Specimen Collection Appointments.*

A weekend home collection sends the specimen by the weekend courier to the reference laboratory. The weekend courier adds to the weekend amount according to the service class of the order collected, as the order's record in Laboratory Test Orders shows that class.

**Clause.** The weekend courier to the reference laboratory adds 25.00 when the order collected is of the Esoteric Reference Testing or Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class, adds 15.00 when it is of the Specialty Clinical Testing, Molecular Infectious Disease Testing or Clinical Toxicology Testing class, and adds nothing for any other class.

| Service class of the order collected | Weekend courier (USD) |
|---|---|
| Esoteric Reference Testing; Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 25.00 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing; Molecular Infectious Disease Testing; Clinical Toxicology Testing | 15.00 |
| Routine Clinical Testing; Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | Nothing |

**Readings (hypothetical).** A Sunday home visit collecting an Esoteric Reference Testing order: courier 25.00. A Saturday visit collecting a Routine Clinical Testing order: nothing added.
